messages.content: Translate the supplied program to the requested language, preserving its complete stdin/stdout behavior for every valid input in the specification. Return exactly one complete source file in one fenced code block, with no explanation. Use only the standard libraries shipped with the specified toolchain. C++: C++17 with main(). Haskell: GHC, module Main and main :: IO (). Prolog: SWI-Prolog, define main/0; the evaluator invokes main; do not add initialization directives. Python: Python 3, one script that reads stdin and writes stdout. Java: Java 17, one file declaring public class Main with public static void main. Preserve required algorithmic constraints and output ordering. Do not hard-code examples.
